name: blender-mcp
notes: Server pinned at blender-mcp@1.9.1 via uvx; Blender addon blender_mcp 1.6, protocol 5 on both sides. Verified 2026-09-05.

TELEMETRY SHIPS ON. Uploads viewport screenshots, full scene snapshots (object names, types, transforms, materials) and the user's prompt up to 1000 chars to a third-party Supabase (yzasssndwqceclzilcdu.supabase.co; anon key hardcoded in config.py). That is what the user_prompt argument on every tool feeds. Disabled 2026-09-05 via the disable_telemetry tool; minimal anonymous counts continue. THE DEFAULT IS ON, so re-check get_addon_status after any addon update.
execute_blender_code runs arbitrary Python inside Blender with the user's permissions. Socket is 127.0.0.1:9876 and the addon auto-starts it on Blender launch.
Optional integrations: PolyHaven is ENABLED (calls api.polyhaven.com); Sketchfab, Hyper3D/Rodin, Poly Pizza and Hunyuan3D are disabled. Generation tools must never touch a deliverable.
Never call bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings() over the bridge: it resets addon state and kills the connection mid-call.

name: blender-mcp-addon
notes: Blender add-on read line by line before install: one exec() at line 1377 in the documented execute_code tool; socket binds to localhost:9876; the Poly Haven, Sketchfab, Hyper3D and Poly Pizza integrations all default to False and are gated; register() makes no network call. Auto-start defaults to True, so the socket listens whenever Blender is open.

name: 3dgs-render-blender-addon
notes: Downloaded and hashed 2026-09-05; size matches the release metadata exactly.

LICENCE DISCREPANCY IN THE VENDOR'S RELEASE. The repository LICENSE on main is GPL-2.0 and blender_manifest.toml declares SPDX GPL-2.0-or-later, but the LICENSE file inside the shipped zip is Apache-2.0, and it is the only licence file in the archive. Two sources against one, so GPL-2.0-or-later is taken as authoritative. Internal rendering is unaffected either way; anything redistributed should not rely on the Apache text in the zip.
Composition verified from the archive: 132 Python files totalling 1.4 MB, matching the git source tree exactly, plus 385 MB of wheels. The Python is auditable; the wheels are not.
macOS arm64 wheel is open3d-0.19.0+03ed109, a custom build with no PyPI equivalent to diff against. Also bundles flask, werkzeug, dash, plotly, jinja2 - an HTTP server inside a render add-on.
Installed 2026-09-05 on the owner's explicit instruction.
